home.title: Ibiribwa byizewe ku munsi wose w'ishuri, bituruka ku bantu bo hafi.
home.lead: Miveloo ihuza amashuri n'abahinzi, abacuruzi n'amakoperative, kandi ikoresha amakuru kugira ngo ibyemezo byo kugaburira abanyeshuri bisobanuke neza.
home.sampleNote: Ibyerekanwa ni ingero kugeza abagurisha nyakuri batangajwe.
footer.mission: Guhuza amashuri, abatanga ibiribwa, amakoperative n’ibigo binyuranye, tubinyujije mu bisubizo byoroshye kugeraho no mu ikoranabuhanga ry’ubwenge, kugira ngo kubona ibiribwa, gucunga ububiko no gutegura amafunguro y’abanyeshuri birusheho koroha no kunoga.

how.title: Kuva ku murima kugeza mu gikoni cy’ishuri, intambwe ku yindi.
how.lead: Intambwe eshanu zihuza igikoni cy’ishuri n’abantu bahinga ibiribwa.
how.jLead: Dore uko igikoni cy’ishuri n’abantu bahinga ibiribwa bahurira kuri Miveloo.
how.s1b: Abahinzi, abacuruzi, abakwirakwiza n’amakoperative biyandikisha, hanyuma bagashyiraho ibyo bafite: ingano, igipimo, igiciro n’aho biherereye muri rusange. Abatanga ibiribwa ni bo bahitamo ibyo amashuri abona. Gushyiraho ibyo ufite nta kiguzi.
how.s2b: Amashuri ariyandikisha kandi agenzurwa mbere yo gutumiza. Guhitamo “Ishuri” mu kwiyandikisha ntibiguha uburenganzira bwo kugura ubwabyo.
how.s3b: Amashuri yagenzuwe agereranya ibyo atangirwa akohereza ibyo atumije, naho abatanga ibiribwa bagasubiza.
how.s4b: Abatanga ibiribwa barategura bakohereza. Amashuri yemeza ibyahageze akandika ibibazo byabaye. Buri mpinduka iranditswe.
how.s5b: Amakuru y’amateka ari ku rubuga rwawe bwite ni ubuntu; ubusesenguzi bwimbitse ni ubwo guhitamo.
how.supB: Abahinzi, abacuruzi, abakwirakwiza n’amakoperative biyandikisha, hanyuma bagashyiraho ibyo bafite. Gushyiraho ibyo ufite nta kiguzi.
how.schB: Amashuri ariyandikisha kandi agenzurwa mbere yo gutumiza. Amashuri yagenzuwe agereranya ibyo atangirwa akohereza ibyo atumije.
how.bTitle: Abatanga ibiribwa ni bo bahitamo ibyo amashuri abona.
how.bBody: Abahinzi, abacuruzi, abakwirakwiza n’amakoperative bashyiraho ibyo bafite, bakagaragaza gusa amakuru bahisemo. Amashuri yagenzuwe agereranya ibyo atangirwa agatumiza ari mu rubuga rwayo bwite.

sellp.title: Egera amashuri akeneye ibyo uhinga.
sellp.lead: Abahinzi, abacuruzi, abakwirakwiza, ibigo by’ibiribwa, amakoperative n’amatsinda y’abatanga ibiribwa bashobora gushyiraho ibiribwa no kwakira ibyo batumijwe. Kugurisha bisanzwe nta kiguzi cyo gukoresha urubuga.
sellp.sTitle: Intambwe eshanu zo kugurisha ku mashuri
sellp.s1b: Fungura konti y’ubuntu y’utanga ibiribwa cyangwa y’itsinda, kandi urangize kugenzurwa.
sellp.s2b: Igicuruzwa, ingano, igipimo, igiciro n’aho kiherereye muri rusange.
sellp.s3b: Amashuri yagenzuwe arabona ibyo ugurisha akabitumiza.
sellp.s4b: Emera, tegura wohereze. Ohereza ubutumwa ku bagura.
sellp.s5b: Amateka yawe ni ubuntu. Ibikoresho byo guhitamo igihe witeguye.
sellp.bTitle: Ni wowe uhitamo ibyo amashuri abona.
sellp.bBody: Kugurisha bisanzwe nta kiguzi cyo gukoresha urubuga. Ushyiraho gusa amakuru wahisemo, kandi amashuri yagenzuwe atumiza ari mu rubuga rwayo bwite.
sellp.hBody: Kugenzurwa bishobora gusabwa mbere y’uko ibyo washyizeho bigaragara. Amatsinda agaragaza nk’ibiboneka gusa ibyemejwe, ntabwo ari ubushobozi bwo kugereranya.
imp.title: Dutangaza ingaruka zapimwe gusa igihe dufite ibimenyetso.
imp.lead: Miveloo iri mu ntangiriro. Tugaragaza ibiri gukora, ibiri gukorwa n’ibiteganyijwe.
imp.mTitle: Gutuma amafunguro y’ishuri aboneka mu buryo bwizewe.
imp.whyB: Amafunguro y’ishuri aterwa n’uko ibiribwa bigera mu gikoni mu buryo bwizewe. Miveloo ifasha amashuri gushaka ibiribwa, igafasha abatanga ibiribwa kugera ku masoko yizewe, kandi ikoresha amakuru y’ukuri mu kugabanya imyanda n’imikorere idahwitse bishobora kwirindwa.
imp.c2: Gufasha abatanga ibiribwa kugera ku masoko yizewe.
imp.c3: Kugabanya imikorere idahwitse ishobora kwirindwa mu kugura no mu gukwirakwiza.
imp.c4: Gushyigikira ibyemezo byiza ku mafunguro y’ishuri hifashishijwe amakuru y’ukuri.
imp.f1b: Amashuri n’abatanga ibiribwa barabonana nta gukeka.
imp.f2b: Amakuru asobanutse afasha amashuri, abatanga ibiribwa na porogaramu gutegura hakiri kare.
imp.f3b: Amakuru meza afasha kugabanya imikorere idahwitse mu kugura no gutanga ibiribwa by’ishuri.
imp.s1: Miveloo nta mibare y’ingaruka yatangajwe iracyafite. Nitangaza, buri mubare uzagaragaza aho wavuye, igihe urebana n’uburyo wapimwemo.
imp.s2: Icyo ari cyo cyose cyerekanwe ahandi cyanditseho “Amakuru y’ikitegererezo” ni icyo kugereranya, si igikorwa nyacyo cy’ubucuruzi.
imp.todayB: Miveloo iri mu ntangiriro. Tugaragaza ibiri gukora, ibiri gukorwa n’ibiteganyijwe, kandi ntitwatangaza imibare y’abakiriya, aho dukorera cyangwa y’ingaruka tudashobora kwemeza.
